name: Barbarian: Maximum Carnage damage puts the creature it hits into combat (#12084)
contract: Maximum Carnage (talent 561359) makes Unbridled Rage cast the 6 s aura 560933, which casts the damage spell 560932 every second on up to 5 enemies within 8 yd (SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, caster = the player). The DBC gives 560932 SPELL_ATTR1_NO_THREAT, so Spell::DoSpellHitOnUnit passed canInitialAggro = false and an idle creature took the damage without ever engaging the player: it stayed out of combat and, in the open world, regenerated (#12084). A damage spell's tooltip ('swinging your weapon around you dealing ... Physical damage to up to 5 nearby enemies') carries normal threat, as the fork already restores for Witch Hunter, Cultist and Sun Cleric damage spells. A passive hostile creature (faction 14, reaction 0) never starts combat by itself; it must be out of combat before the aura ticks and in combat after its health drops. 560933 is cast directly, as in barbarian-maximum-carnage-7603, because the defect is in the damage spell it fires.
